desc: Derive and prove the compressed fixed-`k` binary DP using only adjacent one-step upgrades, including its transition/savings formula.
Determine the finite range of target frequencies that must be enumerated and analyze time complexity under `|s| <= 2e4`.
Test the derived recurrence and current implementation on the provided examples and representative edge cases.
Implement the final Python `Solution.makeStringGood` method with a 26-count frequency array and optimized fixed-frequency DP.
